LanguageData.DMS_DoorBreaker.label: Door Buster
LanguageData.DMS_DoorBreaker.description: A specially designed grenade launcher that fires shaped-charge warheads with armor-piercing capability using reduced propellant charges. It can also be used as an actual battering ram to smash open weak points in a structure.

LanguageData.DMS_Machete.label: Machete
LanguageData.DMS_Machete.description: A heavy machete purpose-built for cutting a path in jungle combat. With its blade and weight it cuts through most things with ease.

LanguageData.DMS_StunBaton.label: Stun Baton
LanguageData.DMS_StunBaton.description: An electric stun baton designed for non-lethal riot control and for subduing out-of-control mechs. It is commonly used by protectors on security duty to secure occupied areas without causing casualties.
